exposure: Direct obstetric causes of maternal death
cohort: All maternal deaths occurring in the last 4 years at a tertiary health care facility
finding: The study identified direct and indirect causes of maternal deaths and found significant associations between maternal death and period of gestation, mode of delivery, and outcome of delivery, highlighting the need for improved healthcare, especially at primary and secondary levels.
mod_finding: Statistically significant associations were observed between maternal death and (...) mode of delivery and outcome of delivery (P = 0.04 and P < 0.001, respectively).
